en.title: Top K Open Merchants
en.description:
Consider only open merchants and rank them by rating in descending order, then by distance in ascending order, then by original input index in ascending order. Return the first K indices; if fewer merchants are open, return all of them.

This site uses a standard input/output protocol; ranges not given by the source are stated explicitly.
en.input: The first line contains N K, followed by N lines score distance isOpen. The source gives no ranges; this site uses 1≤N≤100000, 0≤K≤100000, ratings 0..10⁹, distances 0..10⁹, and an open flag of 0 or 1.
en.output: Output at most K 0-based indices in ranking order; if there are no results, output an empty line.
en.explanation: Example 1: index 1 is closed, and 2 and 0 have the same rating but 2 is closer, so output 2 0. Example 2: only 3 merchants are open, so return all of them: 2 1 0. Example 3: no merchant is open, so output an empty line.
hints: Filter out the closed merchants, sort by the three ranking keys, and take the first K indices.
